t: What he asked for Madinah when the fever came
a: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ، اللَّهُمَّ وَصَحِّحْهَا
p: Allāhumma ḥabbib ilaynā-l-madīnata ka-ḥubbinā Makkata aw ashadd. Allāhumma wa ṣaḥḥiḥhā
m: O Allah, make Madinah beloved to us as Makkah is beloved to us, or more. O Allah, and make it healthy.
